notes.title: Goblin Log #1 - Haggling Mechanics
notes.content: [p]Welcome to the first entry in our [b]Goblin Log[/b] series! These are going to be brief overviews into specific mechanics you'll find in Gobutiko to give you an idea of what you can expect while running your little shop. This time around we're going to jump right into the central mechanic, [b]Haggling[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Haggling is all about using your dice to manipulate the price and land the best deal by the end of the session.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538267/b89848c8ce41492a30ba9130b4a84eebc3d2db99.gif"][/img][/p][p]That's great, but if all things are equal and both sides just push the price in their favor then how do you guarantee the deal ends in your favor? That's where [b]composure[/b] comes in![/p][p][/p][h1]Composure[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538267/9ce4e191bb7e7af76a88e31b113796aa7357e9eb.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the most important part of landing a good deal. Manipulating it effectively will impact how well you can push prices. Think of it as both your [b]health[/b] and [b]power[/b], since running out of this will immediately end the haggling session and having more than your opponent gives you an advantage in pushing the price. When both sides have an equal amount of [b]composure[/b] then they have equal [b]influence[/b] over the price of the item.[/p][p][/p][p]So, how can we move the needle? Easy, you beat your opponent with your dice until their composure drops enough to affect [b]influence[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538267/4055b18474899422cf3b098c35d225109f2508da.gif"][/img][/p][p]You could also use your dice to regain some of your own. It's important to keep your [b]composure[/b] when haggling, not just for it's affect on price but because that composure will roll over into your next haggling session. It may be worth taking a slightly lower price to ensure you have a good amount of composure going into your next deal![/p][p][/p][h1]Influence[/h1][p]So we covered composure and how it affects your [b]influence[/b], but what exactly does that [b]mean?[/b] This is a multiplier for your dice when they're used to push price. Whatever value your dice[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538267/a0e0fb16ab1c52e57e71af378ef035f0ae1c8cd4.png"][/img] shows is multiplied by [b]influence[/b] and that's how much the price will move. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538267/239ab611327f6a9c3f756c6d821ccb16fe313d40.png"][/img][/p][p]Composure isn't the only thing that affects your [b]influence[/b] though. The original value of the item also determines your base influence. This makes it so haggling over expensive or bundled items is more volatile than if you haggled over a cheap rock. Keep this in mind when deciding whether haggling is worth your time or not. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's it for this entry! Next time I'll go into [b]Core Concepts[/b], which are modifiers you can equip to change the way dice work during a haggling session. Stay Tuned![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538267/4c03a1525b38291c01967b7a80a67351ec642289.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Ending - June 3rd
notes.content:
Our first play-test session will be closing on June 3rd @ ~11pm UTC! 

If you haven't had a chance to participate, don't worry! I will be setting up another session later this summer with new content added based on all your great feedback! I appreciate everyone's help and patience with testing these early builds as we work our way towards the ultimate vision for the game! 

I look forward to sharing more of this goblin's journey through capitalism! 

~See you soon!

notes.title: Try out the Steam Playtest for Gobutiko and become the greatest dice-rolling goblin merchant
notes.content:
In the upcoming game Gobutiko you are a goblin merchant, and of course being greedy you will haggle with your customers by rolling dice to wear them down and push the prices (hopefully) in your favour.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/try-out-the-steam-playtest-for-gobutiko-and-become-the-greatest-dice-rolling-goblin-merchant/

notes.title: Playtest 1 is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]We're live(-ish)![/h1]
The first playtest session is now open to play! If you've previously signed up, you should be able to install the game now. If you haven't, don't worry, I'm flipping the sign up over to open access so you won't have to wait.

[h2]How long is the shop open?[/h2]
This session will run for about two weeks, so you'll have until [b]Monday June 2nd[/b] to take it for a spin. There may be minor updates during that time to address significant issues if necessary. Don't worry, we'll be back later for more test sessions after taking in the feedback and making adjustments.

[h2]How can I submit feedback?[/h2]
You can submit feedback in-game by clicking the [b]Feedback[/b] button found in the pause menu. Feel free to submit more than once if you have additional comments to make later. You can also submit a bug report at anytime by pressing [b]F9 [/b]on your keyboard or [b]Select[/b] on your gamepad (or whatever your gamepad calls the "-" button these days).


You can also submit feedback directly on this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc2u8LubbfAtjLzBb64ZtAjVR_IZZ8kcPuOoIXyLx_9CQbSVQ/viewform?usp=header]form[/url]. It'll be the same questionnaire. 


[h2]Have fun![/h2]

notes.title: Playtests!
notes.content:
[h1]Calling all goblins![/h1]
Hey everyone, I'm currently hard at work crafting the game's first public demo build! I was going to jump straight into one big demo release, but I would like to have that build be as polished as possible before releasing it into the wild (plus I don't want to work on the trailer for it yet). So instead [b]Gobutiko [/b]will be opening sign ups for its first public playtest session!

[h2]What's in the box?[/h2]
The playtest will cover the starting area of the game with a limited item pool. Here's what's in it:
[list]
[*] Tavern interactions
[*] Guild Supply Shop
[*] Random Villager merchants
[*] Run the shop
[*] Basic hand decorating (This means no wall/floor editing just place/move furniture)
[/list]

[h2]When does the shop open?[/h2]
Sign ups should be available starting today May 12th. I'll be submitting a build for review this week, so depending on when that gets approved you can expect the to be able to start playing at this earliest by this weekend, but more likely Monday May 19th.


[h2]Side bar[/h2]
I usually prefer not to talk about things when they're subject to change so things end up feeling a bit quiet on announcements here as I'm always in the shop trying to polish up the counters. You can usually find smaller bite-sized looks at the game's progress over on the [url=https://bsky.app/profile/gobutiko.com]bluesky[/url] account, but I will start making some longer posts here even if they're not set in stone.
